Messages.Author: Cantila
Messages.Body:
If you target cards in ash heap the other players have a right to know
which cards you select, right? But not if you target cards in the
library. So what happens if I choose 2 cards from ash heap and 2 from
the library?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cantila wrote:
> If you target cards in ash heap the other players have a right to know
> which cards you select, right?

Yes.

> But not if you target cards in the
> library. So what happens if I choose 2 cards from ash heap and 2 from
> the library?

You place them on the card. The other players know the 2 ash heap cards.
